scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.android:sync: npm run build --prefix client && node scripts/sync-android-assets.mjs
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradle assembleDebug
